title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 MQTT Service Server-Side Request Forgery Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to access internal resources on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the MQTT service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the user-app account.
